literal_meaning: ঠেলা দেওয়া গাড়ি (push cart or handcart)
figurative_meaning_bn: স্ব-ইচ্ছায় কাজ করে না এমন ব্যক্তি, ঠেললে তবে কাজ করে
figurative_meaning_en: A person who does not work voluntarily and only performs tasks when pushed or compelled
similar_in_english: Needs a kick in the pants
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একটা ঠেলাগাড়ি, নিজে থেকে কোনো কাজ শুরু করে না।
অফিসে ঠেলাগাড়ির মতো লোককে রাখা যায় না।
example_sentences_in_english: He is like a handcart; he doesn't start any work on his own.
You can't keep someone like a pushcart in the office who needs constant prodding.
note: The idiom draws from the imagery of traditional handcarts common in Bengali daily life, symbolizing inertia.
